title: Improving the Energy-Efficiency of the Code Generated by LLMs through Effective Prompting
title_zh: 通过有效提示提升大型语言模型生成代码的能效

paragraphs.en: As AI-assisted programming becomes increasingly mainstream, the environmental impact of AI-generated software has emerged as an important consideration. This motivates evaluating LLM-generated code beyond functional correctness by considering execution efficiency and energy consumption. However, despite substantial advances in code generation, frontier LLMs are rarely evaluated based on the energy efficiency of the code they produce. In this work, we conduct a comprehensive evaluation of 21 prompting strategies for energy-efficient code generation and identify 8 strategies for evaluation across 10 widely used open-weight and proprietary LLMs. We evaluate their effectiveness for both Python and C++ code generation relative to a baseline prompt. Across the evaluated models, the selected prompting strategies achieved energy reductions of up to 25% for Python and 17% for C++ code generation. At the model level, Python energy reductions reached up to 50% for Granite-4.0-H-Small, 39% for Claude 4.5 Haiku, and 28% for MiniMax M3, while C++ reductions reached up to 56% for Granite-4.0-H-Small and 7% for Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct. These results demonstrate that prompting strategies can substantially influence the energy consumption of LLM-generated code, although their effectiveness varies across models and programming languages. Our findings highlight the importance of incorporating energy efficiency into the evaluation and optimization of LLM-based code generation and provide practical insights into designing prompts for more sustainable AI-assisted programming.
paragraphs.zh: 随着人工智能辅助编程日益普及，由人工智能生成的软件对环境的影响已成为一个重要的考量因素。 这促使我们超越功能正确性，从执行效率和能源消耗的角度评估大型语言模型（LLM）生成的代码。 然而，尽管代码生成领域取得了显著进展，前沿的大型语言模型却很少基于其生成代码的能源效率进行评估。 在本项工作中，我们对21种旨在实现高效能源消耗的提示策略进行了全面评估，并从中筛选出8种策略，在10款广泛使用的开源和专有大型语言模型上进行了测试。 我们针对Python和C++两种语言的代码生成，将这些策略与基准提示策略进行了效果对比。 在所有受测模型中，所选提示策略使Python代码生成的能源消耗最多降低了25%，C++代码生成则最多降低了17%。 在模型层面，Granite-4.0-H-Small的Python代码能源消耗最多降低了50%，Claude 4.5 Haiku降低了39%，MiniMax M3降低了28%；而C++代码方面，Granite-4.0-H-Small的最高降幅达56%，Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct则为7%。 这些结果表明，提示策略能够显著影响大型语言模型生成代码的能源消耗，尽管其效果因模型和编程语言的不同而有所差异。 我们的研究结果凸显了将能源效率纳入基于大型语言模型的代码生成评估与优化中的重要性，并为设计更可持续的人工智能辅助编程提示策略提供了实用参考。

paragraphs.en: The rapid transition of software development to Large Language Models (LLMs), along with the increasing role of LLMs in the day-to-day workflows of developers, has created new challenges regarding the amount of energy required to execute code produced by LLMs. While earlier generations of coding assistants were able to assist developers with only a single line of code at a time, today’s agentic AI coding assistants complete entire projects with minimal human input. As a result, AI-assisted development has become a common practice, with 84% of surveyed developers now using or planning to use AI tools, while 51% of professional developers use them daily [ 1 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 软件开发迅速转向大型语言模型（LLM），以及 LLM 在开发者日常工作流程中作用的日益增强，给执行 LLM 生成的代码所需的能源量带来了新的挑战。 虽然早期的编码助手一次只能帮助开发者处理单行代码，但如今的智能体式 AI 编码助手几乎无需人工干预即可完成整个项目。 因此，AI 辅助开发已成为一种普遍实践：在调查的开发者中，84% 的人目前正在使用或计划使用 AI 工具，而 51% 的专业开发者则每天使用这些工具 [ 1 ]。

paragraphs.en: A recent analysis of more than 30 million GitHub commits by around 160,000 developers found that AI wrote roughly 29% of the Python functions contributed by U.S. developers by the end of 2024 [ 2 ] , with developers in 2026 reporting that about 51.9% of their code was AI-generated [ 3 ] . The energy costs associated with AI-created code are quite high. In 2025, the world’s data centers consumed roughly 485 TWh of electricity, a 17% increase over the previous year. This represents around 1.5% of all of the world’s electrical needs. However, it is expected to grow to nearly twice that size by 2030, reaching 950 TWh [ 4 ] . In fact, U.S. based research estimates that data centers could consume about 649 TWh by 2030, accounting for 11.8% of total U.S. electricity, and as much as 15.3% under higher-demand estimates [ 5 ] . Additionally, it is estimated that globally, the IT sector is responsible for roughly 1.5% to 4% of global greenhouse gas emissions [ 6 , 7 ] , comparable to the emissions of the airline industry worldwide [ 8 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 最近对约 16 万名开发者提交的超过 3000 万个 GitHub 提交记录进行分析发现，到 2024 年底，美国开发者贡献的 Python 函数中约有 29% 由人工智能编写 [ 2 ]；而到 2026 年，开发者报告称他们约 51.9% 的代码是由人工智能生成的 [ 3 ]。 与人工智能生成的代码相关的能源成本相当高。 2025 年，全球数据中心消耗了约 485 TWh 的电力，比前一年增长了 17%。 这约占全球总电力需求的 1.5%。 然而，预计到 2030 年，这一数字将增长至近两倍，达到 950 TWh [ 4 ]。 事实上，美国的研究机构估计，到 2030 年，数据中心的耗电量可能达到约 649 TWh，占美国总用电量的 11.8%，而在需求更高的情况下，这一比例可能高达 15.3% [ 5 ]。 此外，据估计，全球 IT 行业约占全球温室气体排放量的 1.5% 到 4% [ 6 , 7 ]，与全球航空业的排放量相当 [ 8 ]。

paragraphs.en: The energy efficiency of LLM-generated code is often much lower than that of human-written solutions, and in some cases LLM-generated code can consume up to 450 times more energy than human-generated canonical solutions [ 9 ] . One key reason is that LLMs frequently use heavier algorithms, additional data structures, and recursive logic, which involve unnecessary computations. This is not a one-time cost, as the energy consumed by code recurs every time it runs. This runtime energy adds to the electricity demand of data centers and the load on already strained power grids. Hence, making LLM-generated code more efficient matters as much fo sustainability as it does for performance.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）生成的代码在能效方面通常远低于人类编写的解决方案，在某些情况下，LLM 生成的代码所消耗的能量可能高达人类编写的标准解决方案的 450 倍 [9]。 一个关键原因是，LLM 经常使用更复杂的算法、额外的数据结构和递归逻辑，这些都会带来不必要的计算。 这并非一次性成本，因为代码每次运行时都会重复消耗能量。 这种运行时的能量消耗会增加数据中心的电力需求，并加重本已紧张的电网负荷。 因此，提升 LLM 生成代码的效率对于可持续发展而言，与提升性能同样重要。

Given the high cost of re-training a pretrained model for energy awareness, prompting provides an alternative method. It is applicable to any model and incurs virtually no cost. However, despite considerable research effort, the current body of evidence on whether prompts reduce energy expenditure is mixed, and nearly all evidence has focused solely on Python [ 11 , 12 , 13 ] .

paragraphs.en: To investigate whether prompt-based design can improve the energy efficiency of LLM-generated code and whether these improvements persist across programming languages, we analyzed the impact of 21 different prompting techniques on the energy efficiency of Python and C++ code generated by 10 popular open-weight and proprietary LLMs. As the dataset, we used 878 benchmark problems from EffiBench [ 14 ] . We extended EffiBench dataset with an execution and validation pipeline for C++ code. From these experiments, we identified the best eight prompt designs that produced the greatest improvements in energy efficiency and selected them for further analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 为了探究基于提示词的设计能否提升大型语言模型（LLM）生成的代码的能效，以及这些改进是否在不同编程语言中保持一致，我们分析了21种不同提示词技术对10款主流开源和闭源LLM所生成的Python及C++代码能效的影响。 作为数据集，我们使用了EffiBench [ 14 ] 中的878个基准问题。 我们为EffiBench数据集扩展了用于执行和验证C++代码的流程。 通过这些实验，我们识别出能带来最大能效提升的八种最佳提示词设计，并选择它们进行进一步分析。

paragraphs.en: In summary, the paper makes the following contributions:
paragraphs.zh: 总而言之，本文做出了以下贡献：

paragraphs.en: We conduct a comprehensive evaluation of 21 prompt engineering strategies for energy-efficient code generation using a stratified subset of 110 problems from the extended EffiBench dataset. The evaluated prompts span both single-turn and multi-turn interactions and combine role-based prompting, few-shot learning, and chain-of-thought reasoning with targeted modifications, including explicit energy-efficiency instructions, coding guidelines, and energy-oriented code examples. This systematic design enables us to isolate and identify prompt characteristics that most effectively improve the energy efficiency of LLM-generated code.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用扩展版 EffiBench 数据集中的一个分层子集（包含 110 个问题），对 21 种用于高效生成代码的提示工程策略进行了全面评估。 所评估的提示涵盖了单轮和多轮交互，并结合了基于角色的提示、少样本学习和思维链推理等方法，同时进行了针对性修改，包括明确的能效指令、编码指南以及面向能源效率的代码示例。 这种系统化的设计使我们能够分离并识别出那些最能有效提升 LLM 生成代码能效的提示特征。

paragraphs.en: From our initial analysis, we identify 8 prompting strategies that consistently improve the energy-efficiency of generated code and evaluate them using 878 problems across 10 popular open-weight and proprietary LLMs.
paragraphs.zh: 根据我们的初步分析，我们识别出 8 种能够持续提升生成代码能效的提示策略，并采用 10 款主流开源和专有大型语言模型（LLM）上的 878 个问题对这些策略进行了评估。

paragraphs.en: We develop a reproducible methodology for accurately measuring the energy consumption of LLM-generated code. Our evaluation framework incorporates language-specific execution environments, standardized benchmarking procedures, and carefully designed baseline and cool-off intervals to minimize measurement noise and enable fair comparisons of prompting strategies.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开发了一种可复现的方法论，用于准确测量由大型语言模型生成的代码所消耗的能量。 我们的评估框架整合了特定语言的执行环境、标准化的基准测试流程，以及经过精心设计的基线和冷却间隔，以最小化测量噪声，并实现提示策略的公平比较。

paragraphs.en: Green Software Practices: Energy costs associated with software have been of concern prior to Large Language Models (LLMs). Lago et al. [ 15 ] point out that sustainability should be considered a primary software quality property rather than an afterthought, and Pinto and Castor [ 16 ] add that energy efficiency is a major issue for application developers and not just for hardware or data center managers. Imran et al. [ 17 ] proposed systematic techniques to identify energy leaks in Java and Python code. Kumar et al. [ 18 ] analyzed the impact of dataframe libraries on the code energy consumption. Apsan et al. [ 13 ] gathered 28 guidelines for writing energy-efficient Python, organized into families such as code optimization, multithreading, native code, function calls, object orientation, and network use. Pereira et al. [ 19 ] measured the energy consumption of 27 programming languages, concluding that the fastest language may not be the most energy-efficient.

paragraphs.en: Efficiency of LLM-generated Code: Increasing numbers of benchmarks demonstrate that although LLMs generate functionally-correct code, the generated code is often inefficient. The EffiBench project [ 14 ] paired each test problem with a hand-coded optimized version, demonstrating that on average the LLM output was much slower. Mercury [ 24 ] expanded upon this, providing a dual-metric to assess both functional correctness and efficiency of generated code. Moreover, Niu et al. [ 10 ] separated two previously conflated aspects of evaluating generated code: correctness and runtime efficiency. Their findings indicated that neither achieving a higher pass rate nor increasing model size resulted in generating code that ran faster. The majority of prior research focused on assessing the runtime of generated code. Our previous research assessed the energy use of 20 different LLMs on 878 different problems [ 9 ] . We observed that LLM-generated code was generally less energy efficient than human-written solutions, with differences reaching several orders of magnitude for certain problem types. Similar findings have been reported in prior studies across different settings, including comparisons of the energy consumption of small and large language models [ 25 ] , as well as comparisons between LLM-generated code and solutions developed by expert green-software developers across multiple hardware platforms [ 13 ] .
paragraphs.zh: LLM生成代码的效率：越来越多的基准测试表明，尽管大型语言模型（LLM）生成的代码在功能上是正确的，但这些生成的代码通常效率低下。 EffiBench项目[14]将每个测试问题与人工编写的优化版本进行对比，结果表明，LLM的输出平均而言要慢得多。 Mercury[24]在此基础上进行了扩展，提供了一套双指标体系，用于评估生成代码的功能正确性和效率。此外，Niu等人 [10]将此前被混为一谈的生成代码评估的两个方面——正确性和运行时效率——区分开来。 他们的研究结果表明，无论是提高通过率还是增大模型规模，都无法生成运行速度更快的代码。 以往的大多数研究都集中在评估生成代码的运行时间上。 我们之前的研究评估了20种不同LLM在878个不同问题上的能源使用情况[9]。 我们观察到，LLM生成的代码通常比人类编写的解决方案能源效率更低，在某些类型的问题中，其差异甚至可达几个数量级。 在不同场景下的先前研究中也报告了类似的结果，包括小型和大型语言模型能耗的比较[25]，以及LLM生成代码与多位硬件平台上由绿色软件专家开发的解决方案之间的比较[13]。

paragraphs.en: Prompting for Efficient Code Generation:
paragraphs.zh: 高效代码生成的提示方法：

paragraphs.en: The substantial computational and financial costs of retraining LLMs have motivated prompt-based approaches for improving code efficiency at inference time without modifying the underlying model. Niu et al. [ 10 ] showed that explicitly prompting models to optimize code, particularly when incorporating a reasoning step, can yield modest but measurable improvements in execution time. Apsan et al. [ 13 ] showed different prompting techniques can have varying and inconsistent effects on the energy efficiency of LLM-generated Python code, with the most energy-efficient prompting strategy varying across execution environments. Cappendijk et al. [ 11 ] reported energy reductions of up to 59.7% for certain problems, but also found that not all problems benefited from prompting and that one prompt increased energy consumption by more than fourfold. Similarly, Ashraf et al. [ 12 ] found that chain-of-thought prompting most consistently reduced energy consumption for smaller models, whereas few-shot prompting produced such improvements less frequently, with the optimal prompting strategy depending on the model. Jonnala et al. [ 26 ] evaluated the impact of Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting on the efficiency of LLM-generated Python code using Greedy problems from the EffiBench dataset and their results showed that the impact of CoT prompting on code efficiency varied across the evaluated models and efficiency metrics. Tuttle et al. [ 27 ] investigated the energy efficiency of code generated by eight LLMs on LeetCode problems, finding that LLM-generated solutions generally lagged behind the most efficient solutions and that the effectiveness of prompting strategies varied across models. Cursaru et al. [ 28 ] evaluated the energy efficiency of Code Llama-generated code across C++, JavaScript, and Python, finding that human-written implementations were generally more energy-efficient, while explicitly prompting the model for energy-efficient code resulted in comparable or worse energy efficiency depending on the programming language and problem. Peng et al. [ 29 ] introduced PerfCodeGen , a framework designed to improve the correctness and runtime performance of LLM-generated code. Their study also found that certain prompting techniques improved performance relative to the baseline prompt, although they did not consistently outperform PerfCodeGen . Huang et al.

paragraphs.en: [ 30 ] introduced EFFI-LEARNER , a multi-iteration self-optimization framework that uses execution-time and memory-usage profiles as feedback to guide LLMs in refining their generated code. Their results demonstrated that incorporating profiling information into the code refinement process can substantially improve the efficiency of LLM-generated code. PIE [ 31 ] demonstrated that retrieval and adaptation techniques can enable LLMs to learn performance-improving edits to existing code, achieving substantial gains in runtime efficiency. More recently, ECO [ 32 ] extended these approaches by providing models with both the root causes of inefficiencies and targeted optimization guidance. However, results for energy-specific improvements remain less consistent.

paragraphs.en: In this study, we use the EffiBench dataset [ 14 ] consisting of 878 Python-solvable programming problems sourced from LeetCode [ 33 ] . We chose EffiBench because it leverages LeetCode’s diverse collection of algorithmic programming tasks with standardized problem statements, making it a well-established benchmark for evaluating code. Additionally, the benchmark provides a comprehensive suite of test cases for each problem, enabling rigorous and consistent assessment of the functional correctness of generated solutions.

paragraphs.en: In addition to the original Python benchmark from EffiBench, we extend the dataset to support C++ evaluation by recreating the evaluation framework while preserving the original correctness criteria. Specifically, we analyze the corresponding LeetCode problem descriptions and C++ solutions available on the AlgoMonster platform to understand the expected C++ function signatures, invocation interfaces, and input data structures. This information guides the conversion of the original Python test cases into C++-compatible input formats, allowing the same test inputs to be applied consistently to both C++ baseline and LLM-generated solutions. For problems involving complex data structures, such as linked lists, graphs, and trees, we additionally define standardized C++ representations and supporting data structures to ensure that these inputs can be consistently constructed, passed to the target functions, and evaluated. We also identify and include the necessary standard library headers and common boilerplate required to compile and execute C++ solutions generated by LLMs. This process enables Python and C++ solutions to be evaluated under equivalent conditions, supporting fair cross-language comparisons.

paragraphs.en: This study evaluates three proprietary large language models from the widely used model providers—GPT-5.6 Terra [ 35 ] from OpenAI, Claude 4.5 Haiku [ 36 ] from Anthropic, and Gemini 3.8 Flash [ 37 ] from Google DeepMind —as well as seven popular open-weight models: Granite-4.0H-Small [ 38 ] , Gemma 4 26B A4B IT [ 39 ] , Muse Glimmer 30B [ 40 ] , GPT-OSS-120B [ 41 ] , Kimi K2.7 Code [ 42 ] , MiniMax M3 [ 43 ] , and Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct [ 44 ] . To provide context for the evaluation and facilitate reproducibility, we document knowledge cutoff dates and the model configurations including API provider and model specific inference-time generation parameters for each evaluated model. The knowledge cutoff dates help assess the likelihood that the benchmark problems and their canonical solutions were included in the models’ training corpora, providing important context for interpreting the results. Since our benchmark includes problems published through the end of 2023, it is likely that these models were exposed to most or all of the benchmark problems and their canonical solutions during training.

paragraphs.en: For C++, the extracted code is first augmented with the necessary header files. Subsequently, a separate C++ source file is generated for each test case associated with the problem, resulting in 100 source files per generated solution. Each source file is compiled into its corresponding executable, which is then executed with a timeout of 10 seconds. Similar to the Python evaluation, a solution is classified as correct only if all executables successfully pass their respective test cases within the allotted time. The executables corresponding to the large test cases for these correct solutions are then preserved for subsequent energy measurements. Figure 2 shows a high-level code evaluation workflow.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 C++，提取出的代码会首先补充必要的头文件。 随后，为与问题相关的每个测试用例生成一个独立的 C++ 源文件，因此每生成一个解决方案就会产生 100 个源文件。 每个源文件都会被编译成对应的可执行文件，然后以 10 秒的时间限制执行该文件。 与 Python 评估类似，只有当所有可执行文件都在规定时间内成功通过各自的测试用例时，该解决方案才会被判定为正确。 随后，这些正确解决方案中对应大型测试用例的可执行文件会被保留下来，用于后续的能量测量。 图 2 展示了一个高级别的代码评估工作流程。

paragraphs.en: To ensure a fair comparison between the proposed prompting strategies and the baseline prompt for each LLM, all validated solutions were evaluated on the same hardware instance under identical execution conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 为确保所提出的提示策略与基线提示在每种大型语言模型（LLM）之间能够进行公平比较，所有经过验证的方案均在相同的硬件实例和完全一致的执行条件下进行了评估。

paragraphs.en: Energy consumption for each generated solution was measured using the perf stat command [ 45 ] . Since perf stat reports package (PKG) and DRAM energy consumption at the system-wide level, an idle baseline was first recorded by leaving the system idle for 3 seconds. The corresponding language-specific solution was then executed while collecting energy measurements. Each validated Python solution was executed 30 consecutive times, whereas all validated C++ executables associated with a solution were executed 40 consecutive times. These repetition counts were selected to ensure that the total measurement duration exceeded 1 second, thereby improving the reliability of hardware energy counter sampling and reducing inaccuracies associated with profiling very short-running programs. A 3-seconds cooldown interval was introduced between consecutive measurements of each solution to allow the system to return to a stable thermal and power state.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 perf stat 命令测量了每个生成解决方案的能耗 [ 45 ]。 由于 perf stat 在系统级报告了封装（PKG）和 DRAM 的能耗，因此首先通过让系统空闲 3 秒来记录一个空闲基准值。 随后在执行对应的特定语言解决方案的同时收集能耗测量数据。 每个经过验证的 Python 解决方案连续执行 30 次，而所有与某个解决方案相关的经过验证的 C++ 可执行文件则连续执行 40 次。 选择这些重复次数是为了确保总测量时间超过 1 秒，从而提升硬件能耗计数器采样的可靠性，并减少分析运行时间极短的程序所带来的不准确性。 在每个解决方案的连续测量之间引入了 3 秒的冷却间隔，以便系统恢复到稳定的热和电源状态。

paragraphs.en: The net energy consumption for each solution was computed by subtracting the corresponding idle baseline energy from the measured execution energy. To reduce measurement noise and improve result reliability, the entire measurement procedure was repeated twice, and the final reported energy consumption was calculated as the average across all repetitions. Figure 3 presents the fine-grained framework used to measure the energy consumption of the LLM-generated Python and C++ solutions for each prompting strategy.
paragraphs.zh: 每个解决方案的净能耗是通过从测得的执行能耗中减去相应的空闲基线能耗计算得出的。 为了减少测量噪声并提高结果的可靠性，整个测量过程重复了两次，最终报告的能耗则通过所有重复测量的平均值计算得出。 图 3 展示了用于测量每种提示策略下 LLM 生成的 Python 和 C++ 解决方案能耗的精细框架。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate prompting strategies that can improve upon the base prompt, we use the EffiBench prompt as the baseline. paragraphs.en: To identify prompting techniques that can consistently encourage the generation of energy-efficient solutions, we developed prompts based on intuitive mechanisms that could guide LLMs toward more energy-efficient code generation. We also examined prior research on prompt engineering and incorporated relevant techniques into our prompt design. The selection was restricted to strategies that rely solely on the capabilities of the LLM and do not require external tools, systems, or feedback mechanisms to guide code generation. Based on this criteria, we aggregated and developed a set of 21 prompting strategies, comprising techniques adapted from existing research as well as custom strategies proposed in this work. These strategies are summarized in Table II .
paragraphs.zh: 为了识别能够持续鼓励生成节能解决方案的提示技术，我们基于一些直观机制设计了提示词，这些机制可以引导大型语言模型（LLM）生成更节能的代码。 我们还研究了关于提示工程的相关研究，并将其中相关的技术整合到了我们的提示词设计中。 所选策略仅限于完全依赖大型语言模型（LLM）自身能力、无需外部工具、系统或反馈机制来指导代码生成的方法。 基于这一标准，我们汇总并开发了一套包含21种提示策略的方案，其中包括从现有研究中改编的技术以及本研究提出的定制策略。 这些策略总结于表II中。

paragraphs.en: Based on the results of the initial analysis, we selected nine prompting strategies for the final evaluation: the baseline EffiBench prompt and eight energy-efficient variants (Prompts 4, 10, 11, 12, 13, 18, 20, and 21) highlighted in Table II . Of these eight variants, five were single-turn strategies (Prompts 4, 10, 11, 12, and 18), while three were multi-turn strategies (Prompts 13, 20, and 21). The multi-turn strategies extend the baseline or selected single-turn prompts (Prompts 0, 4, and 10, respectively) with an additional energy-efficiency refinement step. Separate prompt instances are constructed for Python and C++, with the only difference being the language-specific reference implementation.
paragraphs.zh: 根据初步分析的结果，我们为最终评估选择了九种提示策略：基准 EffiBench 提示以及八种能效更高的变体（提示 4、10、11、12、13、18、20 和 21），这些变体在表 II 中进行了突出显示。 在这八种变体中，有五种是单轮策略（提示 4、10、11、12 和 18），而三种则是多轮策略（提示 13、20 和 21）。 多轮策略通过在基准提示或选定的单轮提示（分别为提示 0、4 和 10）的基础上增加一个额外的能效优化步骤来实现。 我们为 Python 和 C++ 分别构建了独立的提示实例，唯一的区别在于语言特定的参考实现。

paragraphs.en: Among the five single-turn strategies, Prompt 4 extends the baseline user prompt by adopting the persona of a skilled Python/C++ developer and incorporating both general code-efficiency guidelines and language-specific best practices. The general guidelines instruct the LLM to prioritize algorithmic and memory efficiency, as well as performance and resource efficiency, while the language-specific guidelines recommend libraries and programming patterns intended to improve efficiency. Prompt 10 modifies both the system and user prompts. The system prompt assigns the LLM the role of an expert competitive programmer and provides a definition of energy efficiency. The user prompt presents three LeetCode-style problems with their corresponding task descriptions, along with examples of energy-efficient and inefficient code and their associated computational complexities. Prompt 11 retains the system prompt used in Prompt 10 but expands the user prompt to include 11 LeetCode-style problem descriptions, with one problem representing each algorithmic category in the dataset. Each example includes both an efficient and an inefficient solution. The example problems used in Prompts 10 and 11 are drawn from outside the evaluation dataset and therefore do not overlap with the problems used for evaluation. Prompt 12 is adapted from Ashraf et al. [ 12 ] and modifies the system prompt by assigning the LLM the role of a Senior Software Engineer with 10 years of experience. Finally, Prompt 18 modifies both the system and user prompts. Similar to Prompt 12, its system prompt assigns the LLM the role of a Senior Software Engineer with 10 years of experience. paragraphs.en: Due to the computational cost of evaluating all 878 benchmark problems across multiple prompting strategies, we constructed a stratified subset of 110 problems, selecting 10 problems from each of the 11 algorithmic categories to ensure representative coverage of the problem space. Using the EffiBench baseline prompt (Figure 4 ) as the reference, we evaluated 21 prompting strategies across three models: Kimi K2.7 Code, MiniMax M3, and Granite-4.0H-Small. This initial screening was conducted exclusively on Python problems, under the assumption that the effectiveness of prompting strategies would remain consistent across programming languages.
paragraphs.zh: 由于评估所有 878 个基准问题在不同提示策略下的计算成本较高，我们构建了一个分层子集，包含 110 个问题，从 11 个算法类别中各选取 10 个问题，以确保对问题空间具有代表性覆盖。 我们以 EffiBench 基线提示（图 4）为参考，在三种模型上评估了 21 种提示策略：Kimi K2.7 Code、MiniMax M3 和 Granite-4.0H-Small。 这一初步筛选仅针对 Python 问题开展，其假设是提示策略的有效性在不同编程语言中保持一致。

paragraphs.en: Following code generation, functional correctness evaluation, and energy benchmarking, we applied filtering criteria to establish a consistent set of problems for prompt-selection analysis. First, we retained only those problems for which all three models produced correct solutions across the evaluated prompting strategies. Additionally, given the relatively small size of the initial evaluation set, we required each problem to have at least two correct solutions generated by the model. Based on these criteria, we identified 59 problems for which all 22 prompting strategies, including the baseline prompt, produced functionally correct solutions across all three models. This filtered set was subsequently used to identify prompting strategies that consistently reduced the energy consumption of generated code.
paragraphs.zh: 在完成代码生成、功能正确性评估和能源基准测试之后，我们应用了筛选标准，以建立一套用于提示词选择分析的一致性问题集。 首先，我们仅保留了那些在所有三种模型中，通过所评估的提示策略都能生成正确解决方案的问题。 此外，鉴于初始评估集的规模相对较小，我们要求每个问题至少由模型生成两个正确的解决方案。 基于这些标准，我们确定了 59 个问题，在这些问题上，包括基准提示词在内的全部 22 种提示策略在所有三种模型中都能生成功能正确的解决方案。 随后，我们使用这个经过筛选的集合来识别那些能够持续降低所生成代码能源消耗量的提示策略。

These eight prompting strategies were therefore selected for evaluation on the extended EffiBench dataset across all ten models and for both Python and C++ code generation.

paragraphs.en: The above eight selected prompting strategies, together with the baseline prompt, were subsequently evaluated on our extended EffiBench dataset across all LLMs under study. To ensure a fair and consistent comparison, we restricted the analysis to problems for which all evaluated models produced functionally correct solutions under every prompting strategy for each programming language. This resulted in a common benchmark comprising 537 Python problems and 607 C++ problems. In this shared evaluation set, the proposed prompting strategies reduced energy consumption for several models compared to the baseline prompt. For Python code generation, improvements were observed for all the models under study with Granite-4.0-H-Small, Claude 4.5 Haiku and MiniMax M3 having the maximum reductions in Fig. 7 . For C++ code generation, Granite-4.0-H-Small, Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct, GPT-5.6 Terra, Muse Glimmer 30B, and GPT-OSS-20B showed higher overall energy reductions, listed in descending order of reduction in Fig. 9 . However, the impact of the prompting techniques was not consistent across models, programming languages, or prompting strategies. For a given model and programming language, different prompting strategies could have opposite effects, with some reducing energy consumption and others increasing it relative to the baseline. For example, as shown in Fig. 7 , for Python code generation, GPT-OSS-120B achieved an energy reduction with Prompts 4, 10, 11, 12, 18, and 21, while Prompts 13 and 20 resulted in higher energy consumption than the baseline. In addition, the same model could exhibit different energy-consumption trends across Python and C++ code generation. For example, Gemma 4 26B A4B IT reduced energy consumption for Python code generation but increased energy consumption relative to the C++ baseline for C++ code generation.
paragraphs.zh: 随后，我们将上述八种选定的提示策略与基准提示一同，在扩展后的 EffiBench 数据集上针对所有研究的 LLM 进行了评估。 为确保公平且一致的比较，我们将分析范围限制在那些所有被评估模型在每种编程语言的每种提示策略下都能生成功能正确解的问题上。 由此得到了一个包含 537 个 Python 问题和 607 个 C++ 问题的通用基准测试集。 在这个共享的评估集中，与基准提示相比，所提出的提示策略降低了多个模型的能源消耗。 在 Python 代码生成方面，所有研究的模型都表现出改进，其中 Granite-4.0-H-Small、Claude 4.5 Haiku 和 MiniMax M3 在图 7 中实现了最大的能源消耗降低。 在 C++ 代码生成方面，Granite-4.0-H-Small、Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct、GPT-5.6 Terra、Muse Glimmer 30B 和 GPT-OSS-20B 表现出更高的总体能源消耗降低，其降低幅度按降序排列于图 9 中。 然而，提示技术的影响在不同模型、编程语言或提示策略之间并不一致。 对于给定的模型和编程语言，不同的提示策略可能产生相反的效果：某些提示策略相对于基准提示降低了能源消耗，而另一些则增加了能源消耗。 例如，如图 7 所示，在 Python 代码生成中，GPT-OSS-120B 在使用提示 4、10、11、12、18 和 21 时实现了能源消耗降低，而提示 13 和 20 则导致能源消耗高于基准水平。 此外，同一模型在 Python 和 C++ 代码生成中可能表现出不同的能源消耗趋势。 例如，Gemma 4 26B A4B IT 在 Python 代码生成中降低了能源消耗，但在 C++ 代码生成中相对于 C++ 基准提示的能源消耗有所增加。

paragraphs.en: Since most of the filtered prompting strategies reduced energy consumption for Python code generation across the evaluated models, we further examined the prompts that consistently improved energy efficiency across all models. paragraphs.en: Explicitly prompting LLMs to prioritize energy efficiency frequently resulted in implementations that consumed less energy than those generated using the baseline prompt, demonstrating that many models can adapt their optimization objective when explicitly instructed. For Python code generation, the largest improvements were observed with Prompt 20 for Granite-4.0-H-Small, reducing energy consumption by approximately 50 % 50\% , Prompt 21 for Claude 4.5 Haiku, achieving a 39 % 39\% reduction, and Prompt 13 for Minimax M3, reducing energy consumption by approximately 28 % 28\% . Similar trends were observed for C++ code generation, where Granite-4.0-H-Small achieved a 57 % 57\% reduction in energy consumption with Prompt 13, while Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct achieved an improvement of approximately 7 % 7\% using Prompt 12. These results suggest that several LLMs already possess the capability to generate more energy-efficient implementations, but this capability is not consistently expressed unless explicitly encouraged through prompting.

paragraphs.en: Despite these encouraging improvements, the effectiveness of energy-aware prompting varied considerably across models and programming tasks. In several cases, the proposed prompts produced implementations that consumed more energy than those generated using the baseline prompt. For instance, Prompt 13 increased the energy consumption of GPT-OSS-120B by up to 74 % 74\% for Python code generation, while Prompt 21 increased the energy consumption by 22 % 22\% for C++ code generation. This inconsistency is particularly noteworthy because all programming problems in our benchmark were published by the end of 2023, making it likely that both the benchmark problems and their canonical solutions were included in the training corpora of many evaluated models. Despite this, explicitly instructing models to prioritize energy efficiency did not consistently result in lower-energy implementations. Instead, the observed variability suggests that current LLMs do not reliably optimize for energy-efficiency during code generation and may instead favor competing objectives such as readability, generality, or commonly learned implementation patterns. Consequently, energy-efficient coding strategies, even if present within the models’ learned representations, are not consistently elicited through prompting alone across different tasks and models.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管这些改进令人鼓舞，但能源感知提示的有效性在不同模型和编程任务中差异显著。 在某些情况下，所提出的提示生成的实现比使用基线提示生成的实现消耗更多能源。 例如，在 Python 代码生成中，提示 13 使 GPT-OSS-120B 的能源消耗增加了高达 74%（74\%），而在 C++ 代码生成中，提示 21 使其能源消耗增加了 22%（22\%）。 这种不一致性尤其值得注意，因为我们基准测试中的所有编程问题都在 2023 年底之前发布，因此很可能基准问题和其标准解决方案都已包含在许多被评估模型的训练语料中。 尽管如此，明确指示模型优先考虑能源效率，并未始终导致能源消耗更低的实现。 相反，观察到的差异表明，当前的 LLM 在代码生成过程中并不可靠地优化能源效率，反而可能更倾向于可读性、通用性或常见实现的模式等相互竞争的目标。 因此，即使能源高效的编码策略存在于模型的学习表示中，仅通过提示在不同任务和模型中也无法始终如一地激发这些策略。

sents.zh: 尽管这些改进令人鼓舞，但能源感知提示的有效性在不同模型和编程任务中差异显著。

sents.en: In several cases, the proposed prompts produced implementations that consumed more energy than those generated using the baseline prompt.
sents.zh: 在某些情况下，所提出的提示生成的实现比使用基线提示生成的实现消耗更多能源。

sents.en: For instance, Prompt 13 increased the energy consumption of GPT-OSS-120B by up to 74 % 74\% for Python code generation, while Prompt 21 increased the energy consumption by 22 % 22\% for C++ code generation.
sents.zh: 例如，在 Python 代码生成中，提示 13 使 GPT-OSS-120B 的能源消耗增加了高达 74%（74\%），而在 C++ 代码生成中，提示 21 使其能源消耗增加了 22%（22\%）。

sents.en: This inconsistency is particularly noteworthy because all programming problems in our benchmark were published by the end of 2023, making it likely that both the benchmark problems and their canonical solutions were included in the training corpora of many evaluated models.
sents.zh: 这种不一致性尤其值得注意，因为我们基准测试中的所有编程问题都在 2023 年底之前发布，因此很可能基准问题和其标准解决方案都已包含在许多被评估模型的训练语料中。

sents.en: Despite this, explicitly instructing models to prioritize energy efficiency did not consistently result in lower-energy implementations.
sents.zh: 尽管如此，明确指示模型优先考虑能源效率，并未始终导致能源消耗更低的实现。

sents.en: Instead, the observed variability suggests that current LLMs do not reliably optimize for energy-efficiency during code generation and may instead favor competing objectives such as readability, generality, or commonly learned implementation patterns.
sents.zh: 相反，观察到的差异表明，当前的 LLM 在代码生成过程中并不可靠地优化能源效率，反而可能更倾向于可读性、通用性或常见实现的模式等相互竞争的目标。

sents.en: Consequently, energy-efficient coding strategies, even if present within the models’ learned representations, are not consistently elicited through prompting alone across different tasks and models.
sents.zh: 因此，即使能源高效的编码策略存在于模型的学习表示中，仅通过提示在不同任务和模型中也无法始终如一地激发这些策略。

paragraphs.en: Limitations: This study has certain limitations:(1) The benchmark used for this evaluation has an imbalanced difficulty distribution, containing substantially more medium-difficulty problems than easy or hard problems.(2) Although the benchmark covers several algorithmic domains, it does not encompass the full diversity of programming tasks encountered in practice. (3) Our experiments were limited to Python and C++ and do not include the effect of our prompting strategies on other programming languages.
paragraphs.zh: 局限性：本研究存在某些局限性：(1) 本次评估所用的基准测试集的难度分布不均衡，其中中等难度的问题数量远多于简单或困难的问题。(2) 尽管该基准测试集涵盖了多个算法领域，但并未包含实际编程任务中可能出现的全部多样性。 (3) 我们的实验仅限于 Python 和 C++，并未涉及我们的提示策略对其他编程语言的影响。

paragraphs.en: Future Work: To address these limitations and the broader challenges of LLM-based code generation, future work could extend this study to additional programming languages to evaluate whether the observed benefits of energy-aware prompting generalize beyond Python and C++. Investigating automated prompt optimization techniques, such as harness engineering, inference-loop optimization, and model-specific prompting strategies tailored to the characteristics of individual LLMs, may further improve the generation of energy-efficient code. Although the selected prompting strategies achieved substantial reductions in execution energy for several models, they also required significantly more tokens, increasing the computational and energy costs of inference. Consequently, the overall energy efficiency of an LLM-based code generation pipeline should account for both the inference energy and the execution energy of the generated code. Future research should therefore explore approaches that improve execution efficiency while minimizing inference overhead, such as fine-tuning LLMs on energy-efficient programming practices or developing concise prompting strategies that consistently elicit energy-efficient implementations.
paragraphs.zh: 未来工作：为了解决这些局限性以及基于大型语言模型（LLM）的代码生成所面临的更广泛挑战，未来的研究可以扩展本研究至其他编程语言，以评估所观察到的能源感知提示方法的优势是否适用于 Python 和 C++ 之外的语言。 探索自动化的提示优化技术，例如提示工程、推理循环优化以及针对各大型语言模型特性量身定制的特定提示策略，可能进一步提升高效能代码的生成效果。 尽管所选的提示策略在多个模型中显著降低了执行能耗，但它们也消耗了更多令牌，从而增加了推理的计算和能源成本。 因此，基于大型语言模型的代码生成流程的整体能源效率应同时考虑推理能耗和所生成代码的执行能耗。 因此，未来的研究应探索既能提升执行效率又能最小化推理开销的方法，例如在大型语言模型上针对高效编程实践进行微调，或开发能够稳定引导出高效能实现的简洁提示策略。
